To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the CSCMM is a novel model that extends existing security models to a capability maturity model with a metrics framework.

(1) the CSCMM provides a systematic and structured approach to assess the overall cyber cloud security status of an organization; and (2) the proposed security metrics provide a set of measures to assess the security status of each security domain in the CSCMM.

(a) CSCMM can provide a comprehensive approach to assess the security status of a given cloud system, and to determine the security improvement needs of the system; (b) The proposed metric framework is a comprehensive and systematic way to assess the security maturity of a cloud system; (c) CSCMM is a practical model for security management in cloud environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a systematic approach to assess cloud security maturity levels and to identify security gaps and improvement areas in a systematic way.
the development of an approach to assess cloud security maturity and to evaluate the effectiveness of security measures.
the development of a capability maturity model and a metric framework that can be used to assess the maturity levels of a cloud system in terms of security.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CSCMM is a practical and useful tool for cloud security management and it is expected to be a reference point for cloud security research and practice.
CSCMM can be used to assess and measure the maturity of cloud security in terms of security metrics and it can be a valuable tool for cloud security management.
the proposed CSCMM and security metric framework can be used to assess the overall cloud system security and to improve its security status.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a new capability maturity model for cloud security that provides a comprehensive and systematic approach to measure the maturity of cloud systems and to assess the security status of a system.

CSCMM can be used to assess the overall cloud security status of an organization, to improve security practices, to provide a common understanding and a shared vision of cloud security among stakeholders and to provide a common framework for security metrics.
we provide a capability maturity model for cyber cloud security, which can be applied to any cloud service and cloud provider, to assess their security status.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CSCMM is a comprehensive model that covers the whole lifecycle of a cloud environment and it provides a set of security metrics to evaluate the security status of a system.
the CSCMM can be used as a security management tool to assess security status of cloud systems.
CSCMM can be used as a reference model to assess security maturity levels of a cloud environment and the security metrics can be used for measuring and evaluating security status of the system.
